small-wins-big-life.description: Big change does not require big actions — it requires small wins, repeated. Learn how tiny habits build a big life.

smart-goals.title: SMART Goals: The Framework That Actually Works
smart-goals.description: Stop setting vague goals. The SMART framework — Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound — turns wishes into results.

social-muscle.title: The Social Muscle — Why Connection Is a Discipline
social-muscle.description: A powerful social lesson is not about tactics — it is about showing up. Connection, like any muscle, grows only with reps.

solo-travel-stronger-self.title: Solo Travel, Stronger Self
solo-travel-stronger-self.description: Travel alone once and you learn what you are made of. The world becomes quiet enough to hear yourself.

sprint-90-jours.title: The 90-Day Sprint: Why Quarterly Goals Beat Annual Goals
sprint-90-jours.description: Annual goals are too distant to create urgency. 90-day goals create focus, momentum, and accountability. Learn the power of quarterly sprints.

standard-non-negociable.title: The Non-Negotiable Standard: How to Set Rules That Never Bend
standard-non-negociable.description: The most disciplined people have one thing in common: non-negotiable standards. Learn how to set rules that create consistency without willpower.

strength-is-a-skill.title: Strength Is a Skill, Not a Talent
strength-is-a-skill.description: Strength is not given — it is practiced. Every rep is a lesson in patience and form.

styles-attachement.title: Attachment Styles: Why You Love the Way You Do
styles-attachement.description: Your attachment style shapes how you love, how you fight, and how you handle separation. Understanding it changes everything.

success-is-a-direction.title: Success Is a Direction, Not a Destination
success-is-a-direction.description: Stop waiting to arrive. Success is not a place you reach — it is the way you walk.

success-leaves-traces.title: Success Leaves Traces
success-leaves-traces.description: Success is not a mystery — it leaves traces. Follow the traces, not the trophy.

syndrome-imposteur.title: Imposter Syndrome: Why You Feel Like a Fraud and How to Stop
syndrome-imposteur.description: 70% of people experience imposter syndrome. It is not a sign of inadequacy — it is a sign of growth. Learn to recognize and overcome it.

systemes-battent-motivation.title: When Motivation Fails, Systems Take Over
systemes-battent-motivation.description: Motivation is unreliable. Systems are dependable. Learn why building systems beats setting goals — and how to create systems that work.

technique-pomodoro.title: The Pomodoro Technique: Work Smarter, Not Harder
technique-pomodoro.description: The Pomodoro Technique is the simplest productivity system in the world. Work for 25 minutes, break for 5, repeat. Here is why it works.

the-comeback-is-stronger.title: The Comeback Is Always Stronger Than the Setback
the-comeback-is-stronger.description: Every setback is a setup for a stronger comeback. Your greatest growth is not in never falling — it is in rising with more fire.

the-cost-of-success.title: The Cost of Success No One Talks About
the-cost-of-success.description: Every success has a price paid in advance — in boredom, in no, and in staying when it would be easier to leave.

the-detour-is-the-destination.title: The Detour Is the Destination
the-detour-is-the-destination.description: The best travel stories never happened on the planned route. They happened on the detour you almost skipped.

the-goal-behind-the-goal.title: The Goal Behind the Goal: The Hidden Question That Keeps You Going When the Plan Stops Working
the-goal-behind-the-goal.description: Every goal hides a deeper goal — a why beneath the why. Most people chase the surface. The few who arrive are the ones who dug past the first layer.

the-letter-he-never-sent.title: The Letter He Never Sent — And the Day It Changed His Life
the-letter-he-never-sent.description: He wrote it in rage. He never mailed it. But every morning, for forty years, he read it again — and made the same quiet choice. Sometimes the unsaid letters write our lives.

the-morning-athlete.title: The Morning Athlete: Why 5 AM Still Wins (And How to Actually Do It)

the-movie-that-changed-your-week.title: The Movie That Changed Your Week
the-movie-that-changed-your-week.description: A good film does not just entertain — it rearranges you. Choose stories that profit your life.

the-plate-that-keeps-you-steady.title: The Plate That Keeps You Steady
the-plate-that-keeps-you-steady.description: A steady plate makes a steady day. Learn the simple ratio that keeps energy even and cravings quiet.

the-shop-that-stayed-open.title: The Shop That Stayed Open: Why Endurance Beats Pivoting
the-shop-that-stayed-open.description: Everyone else pivoted. He stayed. For 32 years, the doors opened at 7 a.m. — and the lessons he learned inside are the ones most professionals never find. A story about quiet endurance.

time-blocking-journee.title: Time Blocking: How to Own Your Day Instead of Reacting to It
time-blocking-journee.description: Time blocking is the practice of assigning every hour of your day to a specific task. Learn how to take control of your calendar and your life.

trouver-voix.title: Speaking Up: How to Find Your Voice and Use It
trouver-voix.description: Your voice matters. But if you never use it, no one will hear it. Learn how to speak up with clarity, conviction, and confidence.

two-friends-one-promise.title: Two Friends, One Promise: Why Community Is Kept, Not Found
two-friends-one-promise.description: They promised to walk every day for a year. The promise, not the walk, is what changed them. A story about accountability, community, and the difference between a habit and a commitment.

two-minute-breath-reset.title: The Two-Minute Breath Reset
two-minute-breath-reset.description: You cannot think your way calm — you breathe your way there. Two minutes is enough to change your state.

two-minute-threshold.title: The Two-Minute Threshold
two-minute-threshold.description: A habit is not a finish line but a doorway. Shrink it until it becomes impossible to skip, and the doorway stays open forever.

tyranny-of-the-visible-timeline.title: The Tyranny of the Visible Timeline
tyranny-of-the-visible-timeline.description: Most quitting has nothing to do with the goal being wrong. It has to do with the clock being visible.

vaincre-procrastination.title: How to Stop Procrastinating — The Real Science Behind Procrastination
vaincre-procrastination.description: Understand why you procrastinate and learn proven techniques to beat it forever. Practical strategies to take action now.

viral-mindset-shift.title: The Viral Mindset Shift — How One Idea Changes Everything
viral-mindset-shift.description: A powerful mindset clip, 27 seconds long: identity precedes outcome. Here is the full story behind a transformative idea on motivation.

voyage-budget.title: Budget Travel: How to See the World Without Going Broke
voyage-budget.description: Travel does not have to be expensive. With the right strategies, you can see the world on a shoestring budget. Here is how.

voyage-lent.title: Slow Travel: Why Less Destinations Means More Experience
voyage-lent.description: Rushing through 10 cities in 10 days is not travel — it is tourism. Slow travel is about depth, not breadth. Learn why less is more.

voyage-sante-mentale.title: Travel and Mental Health: How New Places Heal Your Mind
voyage-sante-mentale.description: Travel is not a luxury — it is therapy. New environments reduce stress, boost creativity, and improve mental health. Here is the science.

voyage-solo.title: Solo Travel: Why Everyone Should Travel Alone at Least Once
voyage-solo.description: Solo travel is not about being lonely — it is about being free. Learn why traveling alone is the most transformative experience you can have.

water-before-willpower.title: Water Before Willpower
water-before-willpower.description: Before you reach for willpower, reach for water. Hydration is the cheapest performance enhancer you own.

when-motivation-leaves.title: When Motivation Leaves
when-motivation-leaves.description: Motivation is weather. Discipline is the building you construct so that the weather no longer decides your day.

zone-confort-croissance.title: Comfort Zone vs Growth Zone: Why Discomfort Is Your Friend
zone-confort-croissance.description: Your comfort zone is a beautiful place, but nothing grows there. Learn why stepping into discomfort is the only path to growth.
